requirements.function: 10/14 rounds, final round omits MixColumns, forward/inverse transformations

requirements.scope: All 11 AES-128 / 15 AES-256 expanded round keys, forward and reverse order, for the two FIPS keys. Internal Rcon register and physical RTL key-memory architecture are not observed.
